svg.title: Native Service Bus wake for Hermes cron
svg.desc: A native cron provider queues only the next occurrence. A managed receiver wakes the gateway through OnDemand execution. The runtime claims its existing execution, delivers through the original channel, and the owning connection completes the lease.

g.text: 1. Native cron changes
2. Next occurrence queued
3. Native receiver wakes gateway
4. Runtime claims and executes
5. Originating channel receives
6. Complete the owning lease
Schedule and ledger stay in Worker home
Root disk with native Blob backups
Worker, job, revision, occurrence, due time
No private prompt or document bytes
Platform-owned PeekLock + OnDemand
Gateway may be Memory-suspended
Revision fence and durable execution receipt
No repeated model run on delivery retry
Authenticated conversation binding
Visible result is separate from transport ACK
Renew and settle through caller-owned MI
Native cron arms the next occurrence
Idle actors suspend; no application receive loop stays awake.
Callback success is a durable receipt, never proof that the broker message was acknowledged.
